observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a dark blue/black Sony PS4 console with two controllers placed on top. The console has 'SONY' on the left and 'PS4' on the right of the front panel. The controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 models, one with a blue touchpad and one with a black touchpad.
The console is connected via a cable, likely power or HDMI, and a remote control is visible in the background.

Photo 2 shows a TV screen displaying the PS4 home screen with several game icons visible, including 'EA SPORTS FC 27', 'Tomb Raider', 'Sniper Elite', and others. The time shown is 9:04. The screen has a watermark 'BOLA.O'.

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show the console and controllers in clean condition with no visible damage or heavy wear.
No photo shows the internal storage capacity. The PS4 Pro model typically comes in 1TB, but this cannot be confirmed from the photos alone.
Photos 0 and 1 clearly show two DualShock 4 controllers on top of the console.

Photo 2 shows the PS4 home screen with several games visible, but only a few are identifiable. The total number of games cannot be confirmed from the photo. The claim of 17 games is not verifiable from the provided images.

risks.proof: A photo of the console's system settings screen showing the storage capacity, or a photo of the original box with the model and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard PS4 Pro, which may be 500GB or 1TB; if not 1TB, the price is lower.

risks.risk: Controllers may not be functional or may have battery issues
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers being used with the console, or a photo of the controllers' lights turning on when connected.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if controllers may be non-functional or have battery issues, reducing value.

risks.risk: Games may not be fully installed or may be digital only (not transferable)
risks.proof: Photos of the physical game cases or a screenshot of the game library showing the full list of 17 games with their status (installed, digital, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if games are not included or are digital-only, which may not be transferable to a new user, reducing value.

risks.risk: Console may have hardware issues (e.g., disc reader, cooling, or power supply)
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up, playing a game, and ejecting a disc, or a photo of the console's serial number and model number to verify authenticity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the console may have hidden hardware faults, reducing value.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's system settings screen showing the internal storage capacity.
Video or photo showing both controllers working with the console.
Photo or list of the 17 games included, preferably with physical cases or digital library screenshot.
Video showing the console booting up, playing a game, and ejecting a disc.
response.reason: The console is identifiable as a PS4 Pro, and two controllers are visible. However, key claims such as 1TB storage and 17 games cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks like controller functionality, game transferability, and console health require additional proof before pricing can be accurately determined.
